labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I didn't mean to make them work overtime.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Intentions don't turn themselves into staffing schedules.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Ishigami closes the schedules and looks at Sakaguchi.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I'm not here to stop you from operating.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Doctors decide when an operation should be done. The nursing department confirms whether there are people who can safely take on the work.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Understood. How should I submit the request, then?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Ishigami seems a little more satisfied with this question than with his earlier explanation.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Send the nursing department the estimated duration, the scrub and circulating nurses required, and the postoperative handover requirements in advance.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “If we can adjust the schedule, I'll agree. If we can't, I'll tell you why.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “And if there really isn't a way to fit it in?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We find the next suitable time together.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She pauses briefly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “This is a hospital. Doctors, nurses, and patients all need to be able to count on arrangements that work for them.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi picks up the request again and turns to the nursing coordination section he had left blank.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then I'll fill this in properly first. I won't promise the patient a specific time before the nursing department confirms it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “That's right.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “From now on, I'll notify the nursing department first when adding an operation at short notice.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “No need to wait until next time. Finish this one first.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi cannot help smiling a little. Ishigami's expression does not change.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Head Nurse Ishigami, I suspect I'll be troubling you quite often from now on.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “If you fill in the information clearly, it isn't trouble.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She picks up the nursing allocation schedule, preparing to leave.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “One more thing.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “When the wards are busy, please don't discuss who is unwilling to work overtime in front of patients.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The nursing department will handle the coordination. All the patient needs to know is whether the hospital has made proper arrangements for her.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I'll remember that.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body:
Ishigami nods slightly and leaves the nurses' station with the schedules. She does not smile or add any polite pleasantries.

Sakaguchi looks at the unfinished request in his hand, picks up a pen, and fills in the

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: estimated duration, staffing needs, and handover arrangements in the nursing coordination section.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: As Sakaguchi passes the nurses' station, he sees Hiroko Sugimura checking handover documents with a young nurse wearing black-framed glasses. The girl's voice is quiet, but she explains every item clearly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The patient in bed seven has completed all her preoperative tests. She says she doesn't want to cancel the operation. She just wants someone to tell her when they'll come to collect her.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Right. Then confirm the expected transfer time, too. Don't just write ‘explained.’”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes, I've already asked the operating room. Once she heard the time, she finally put down that information leaflet.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Good. You remembered what the patient was actually worried about. That's more important than filling every box on the form.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Thank you. I still have a long way to go, though...”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I've always looked up to you, Hiroko.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I want to be a nurse like you, someone who helps patients feel at ease.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then start with today's handover. You're already doing well.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi approaches the counter. Hiroko looks up, and Satsuki turns with her. The instant she sees who it is, the hand reaching for her glasses freezes in midair.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Good morning, Hiroko. Do I confirm this transfer arrangement with you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes, Doctor. Perfect timing—let me introduce you. This is Satsuki Orikawa. She's recently started working alongside me to learn the routines.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Satsuki, this is Dr. Ryuji Sakaguchi from surgery.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “S-Sakaguchi... D-Doctor...!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hello, Orikawa. I heard your handover just now. Your notes were very clearly organized.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Th-thank you! N-no, I mean, I'm still... um...”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki's voice grows quieter and quieter. Instinctively, she moves half a step behind Hiroko, her fingers still gripping the handover folder tightly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Satsuki, put the file down for a moment. The doctor is only saying hello.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I-I'm sorry! I know...”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It's all right. If you have any questions about transfers or handovers, just ask me directly.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “A-ask you... directly?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course. You don't have to pass everything through Hiroko.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction
H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Only after making sure Sakaguchi is no longer looking her way does Satsuki slowly loosen her grip on the folder and bow her head to apologize to Hiroko.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hiroko... was I terribly rude just now?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You greeted the doctor, and you didn't hold up the handover. Your nerves were just a little too obvious.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Ugh... I know. I had it all ready in my head, but when I saw a male doctor coming toward me, I forgot everything.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You didn't forget what to say when you were talking about the patient.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Th-that's work. The patient is waiting. Of course I have to explain things clearly...”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: As she says this, she looks down and leafs through the duty roster in her hands. Her fingertip pauses between the surgery and gynecology columns.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I really did want to be a surgical nurse like you, Hiroko...”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But I applied to gynecology after all.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Because there are fewer male patients?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...Because there aren't any male patients.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Hiroko looks at her, then at the ward information in her hand, as though she has finally realized they have been talking about different things from the start.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Satsuki, didn't you know?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “This hospital only admits female patients.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction
H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki abruptly raises her head, and her black-framed glasses slide a little down her nose. Holding the frames, she stares at Hiroko, clearly reconsidering what her department application actually meant.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: GYNECOLOGY NURSES’ STATION — DAY

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki is sorting charts behind the counter when Aqua walks straight toward her.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Orikawa. Come with me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes, Chief. Is there a patient?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “No. A live-subject test.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…What?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Aqua is already walking away.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Quickly.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki hurries after her with the charts.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Chief, what do you mean by live—”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: GYNECOLOGY EXAM ROOM

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: A new electric examination chair stands in the center. Sakaguchi is reading its manual beside the controls.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki stops for half a beat when she sees Sakaguchi.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…D-Dr. Sakaguchi.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Nurse Orikawa.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi merely greets her and does not approach. Satsuki adjusts her glasses.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “W-Why are you in gynecology…?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I called him. It’s new.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Aqua pats the examination chair’s armrest.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Aqua wants to see whether the team’s positions get in the way during actual use.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “And the leg supports.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki looks from the chair to Aqua.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So… who is the live subject?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Lie down for us.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Me? Why me?!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Because you are here. We are only testing positioning. No examination.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki remains standing and glances unmistakably at Sakaguchi. Aqua follows her gaze and finally understands.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Oh. Dr. Sakaguchi will not affect the angle of the leg supports.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The leg-support angle is not the problem!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi takes two steps back on his own.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I will stand here. If that is still uncomfortable, I can leave.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki exhales slowly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…This is only a test, right? No surprise examination?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “No.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You promise, Chief?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Why would I lie about that?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Because it is you…”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I heard that.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki removes her nursing shoes, straightens her uniform skirt, and sits on the chair. Aqua gives her a medical drape.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki remains in uniform and wears her black-framed glasses. Her legs rest in the supports under a proper medical drape. Sakaguchi stays at a distance, watching the equipment and team positions.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Aqua adjusts a leg support.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Here?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…A little lower.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Aqua lowers the support another notch.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “That is about right.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then the supports are fine.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Without warning, Aqua presses the control.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The motor whirs; the backrest lowers as the leg supports rise slightly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki grabs the armrests.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “W-Wait!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Aqua stops immediately.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Did it pinch you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “No!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then what is wrong?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki’s expression shifts from alarm to thought.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…You did not tell me it was about to move.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course the chair moves.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I know. But when you are lying here… you do not know when it will move.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Aqua pauses and writes on her clipboard.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Warn the patient before a position change.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The chair reclines. Only the ceiling and examination light remain visible. Aqua is reduced to the edge of the frame, while Sakaguchi has stepped completely out of view. The supports and preparations cannot be seen.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki lifts her head slightly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Chief, stand where you would during an examination.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Aqua moves to the foot of the chair.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Here?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…I cannot see you.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course. This is where I stand for the examination.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “That is exactly why it is frightening.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “When a nurse is standing, it feels as though the doctor is right beside the patient. Once you lie down, all you can see is the light.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You hear footsteps, drawers, and instruments… but you do not know what anyone is about to do.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Aqua keeps writing. Sakaguchi lowers the manual and listens closely.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Aqua asks Sakaguchi to take the usual assistant’s position. He moves beside the equipment without approaching Satsuki.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Aqua stands at the foot and Sakaguchi at the side. The patient is quickly surrounded, and Satsuki visibly tenses.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “What is wrong?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…It feels crowded.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “There are only two of us.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It feels like only two when you are standing. It does not when you are lying down.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Is it uncomfortable?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I’m fi—”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki stops, surprised by herself.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…See? I almost said, ‘I’m fine.’”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Patients do this too. Especially once they are positioned and everyone is waiting.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “She may feel… that saying she is uncomfortable would inconvenience everyone.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So we cannot simply ask, ‘Are you okay?’”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Right. It is better to ask something specific.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Are the supports pressing anywhere? Is there a gap under the lower back? Are you cold?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Or tell her directly that if anything is uncomfortable, we can readjust it now.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Aqua returns to the examination position with an impeccably professional expression.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Orikawa, relax.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction
H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki becomes even more rigid.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You did not relax.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Because all you said was ‘relax’!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I told you to relax, so relax.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I cannot!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi turns his face aside, suppressing a smile. Satsuki notices and blushes more deeply.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Dr. Sakaguchi, please do not laugh…”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I was not laughing.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You were!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then what should I say?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki thinks for several seconds before answering seriously.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “First, tell the patient what will happen next.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Her voice softens into her nursing tone.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Next, the chair will recline a little farther and the leg supports will rise.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It may be a little uncomfortable. If it hurts or frightens you, tell me immediately.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You do not have to endure it. We can stop at any time.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The room falls quiet. Aqua writes. Satsuki is still in an embarrassing position, but she no longer avoids Sakaguchi’s gaze.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “If we could change only one thing?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “One thing?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “There is not enough time. Choose one.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki considers it.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Advance warning.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Why?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Once the patient knows what will happen next, many things become easier.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Fear, physical tension—even if she wants to refuse, she knows when she needs to speak.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I understand.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki seems to have expected to keep defending her point.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Just like that?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes. You are right.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What you just described is not something a doctor can see while standing.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Especially that an uncomfortable patient may not speak up. I will remember that.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki looks at him. She is still nervous, but for the first time she does not want to retreat. Instead, she looks quietly, uncertainly pleased.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Aqua closes her clipboard.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “All done.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It is over?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes. The backrest is going to rise.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki blinks, then gives a small smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Okay.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The motor starts again. The backrest rises; Satsuki sits up and starts to remove her feet from the supports.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Orikawa, you are very well suited to this.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki looks down at herself, then at the chair.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Being a patient?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Being a nurse.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Doctors easily focus only on whether the examination can be done. You notice what the patient is thinking. That is valuable.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki slowly lowers her head.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Thank you.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Aqua picks up the clipboard.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I am going to ask Equipment Services to change a few settings.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She walks straight out.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki puts her nursing shoes back on. Alone with Sakaguchi, the only man in the room, she adjusts her glasses as some of her tension returns.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Um…”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi does not approach.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Nurse Orikawa, thank you for what you did just now.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I only lay there.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “No. You showed us what people standing beside the chair cannot see.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “If you think something we do will make a patient more anxious, say so directly.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…May I?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Even if the doctors have already decided on the process?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki takes a quiet breath.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Dr. Sakaguchi.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Yes?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: This time, she does not stammer.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Thank you for listening to me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Keep speaking up.”

body: “I will still be nervous.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But…”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “You are right.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Keep speaking up.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: Satsuki stands at the edge of the counter, turning a rotation application over and over. Artoria walks past, then comes back.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You have been staring at that paper for a long time.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Is it that obvious?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It is.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki adjusts her black-framed glasses.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I am only deciding… whether I should really submit it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “A perioperative nursing rotation?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I used to want very much to become an operating-room nurse.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I know.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…You know?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Your eyes are different when you talk about Sugimura than when you talk about other nurses.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki blushes.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Senior Hiroko really is remarkable. When a patient is afraid, she knows when to speak.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “When the doctors are busy, she knows when not to interrupt. She does not panic when something goes wrong.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I used to think… I wanted to become that kind of nurse too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then you went into gynecology.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki’s shoulders draw inward.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Because… there were too many male doctors in surgery.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Do not accept that so calmly! It makes it sound even more embarrassing!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It is your reason. I have no right to be ashamed of it for you.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki falls quiet.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But lately I have been thinking… if every time I become nervous, I choose to avoid that place—”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then I will never know whether I could actually do the work well.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She looks at the application.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Come with me once.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Where?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “You want to apply for a perioperative rotation.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Y-Yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Why?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Her prepared answer catches in her throat.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Because I want to become a better nurse.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “That is an answer, not a reason.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I like my work now. But I realized I never truly let go of that wish.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Did you bring her here to vouch for her?”

body: “No.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “What?”

Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The third patient is an adult woman, Yoriko Nikaido. Her hair is under a surgical cap, and her gown and sheet cover her body. She is trying hard to appear calmer than she feels.

body: “I will confirm once more. Please tell me your name.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Yoriko Nikaido.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Today’s procedure is a laparoscopic cholecystectomy.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Any medication allergies?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “None.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki completes the check. The patient speaks.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Miss Nurse.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Do I look extremely nervous?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki does not deny it reflexively.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…A little.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You really said it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I’m usually the one telling everyone else not to be nervous... It doesn’t seem to work very well today.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I-I’m sorry!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient cannot help smiling.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It is fine. Better than lying that you cannot tell at all.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki relaxes a little too.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I will take you inside. I will stay until the handoff is complete.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Okay.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki pushes the gurney along the corridor. Sakaguchi approaches from the changing area, headed for the same operating room.

Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Orikawa.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki’s shoulders visibly tense.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “D-Dr. Sakaguchi!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient looks up at her.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The surgeon?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient studies her for two seconds, then lies back down.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…I suddenly feel more nervous.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Why did seeing the doctor make you more nervous…?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The automatic door opens. The room is brighter than the corridor; the patient sees the surgical lights, table, anesthesia machine, and waiting staff all at once.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient’s expression changes instantly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Wait.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki does not hear her clearly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The bed moves forward another little bit.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Wait, wait—I heard that once you go in, everyone just focuses on prep and the patient can’t find a chance to say anything—is that true?!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: THUD.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The entire gurney stops abruptly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki looks down at the wheels and tries a little more pressure. The gurney does not move at all.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction
H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Stop pushing—!!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki immediately releases the pressure. Sakaguchi looks toward the front from the side.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: SIDE VIEW OF THE DOORWAY

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient has half sat up. Her legs spread to either side, each foot braced against one side of the entrance. The gurney is halfway through, but she has barred herself in place like a human door bolt.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction
H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The gurney is not stuck.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki looks at the wheels, then at the patient.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…The patient is stuck.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I can hear you!!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The scene pauses for one beat. None of the staff laugh.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki instinctively reaches to pull the gurney back, then stops. She does not touch the patient’s legs. Instead, she moves to where the patient can see her directly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “All right. We will not go in yet.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Really?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Really.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Everyone behind them stops. No one continues pushing. The patient takes several breaths.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I know I already consented. I know the operation is today.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Back in the ward, I still thought I was fine.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She looks into the operating room.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But when the door opened, when I saw that light, suddenly it felt—”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Her feet press harder against the frame.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Like I was really being pushed inside.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki is quiet for several seconds.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…What does ‘yes’ mean?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It means… I think what you feel is normal.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We see this doorway every day, so we forget what it looks like.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But today is the first time you have entered through it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You do not have to put your feet down immediately.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient visibly freezes in surprise.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “First, I will tell you what will happen after we enter.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Okay.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “After we enter, the gurney will first stop beside the operating table.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We will confirm your name, procedure, and wristband once more.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Only after that will we help you move onto the operating table.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Anesthesia will not suddenly begin the moment we enter, and no one will move you without explaining.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What about you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Me?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Will you leave?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I will not leave before the handoff is complete.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: After several seconds, the patient slowly lowers her left foot from the frame. Satsuki still does not move the gurney.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Why are you not pushing?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “There is still one more.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient looks at the right foot still braced against the other side.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...This foot is insurance. You always keep one line of defense.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi turns his face slightly away. He is not mocking her; he is holding back a small smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then... when does the defense come down?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Give me three more seconds.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “All right.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: One second.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Two seconds.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Three seconds.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: At last, the right foot slowly comes back inside.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You cannot push suddenly.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I will not.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki returns to the foot of the gurney and applies only the slightest pressure. It crosses the threshold. The patient does not brace her feet again.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Adult female, Yoriko Nikaido. Wristband confirmed.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Scheduled today for laparoscopic cholecystectomy. No known medication allergies. Preoperative preparation complete.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You stopped at the doorway for a while?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient answers first.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The gurney got stuck.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “No.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Doctor!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What got stuck?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki glances at the patient.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…The patient.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient tucks her feet farther under the sheet.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But I am inside now…”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Hiroko does not press the matter. She only smiles.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes. What matters is that you came in.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She looks back at Satsuki.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Complete handoff. Good work.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki visibly exhales in relief.

Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Orikawa.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki immediately stands straight.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You handled that well.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction
H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But at first I thought a wheel was broken.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then you discovered it was not.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “And then the patient was stuck in the doorway.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You did not fight the gurney.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki clearly imagines herself pushing desperately from behind while the patient braces desperately in front. Her expression changes.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…That would have been terrible.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “That is why you stopped.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I actually… know what that feels like.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Your mind knows what you should do and everyone is waiting, but your body simply will not move.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She adjusts her glasses.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “When that happened to me before, I only thought I was useless.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So when I saw her like that, I realized that if someone kept pushing, she would only become more afraid.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then you are very well suited to this work.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…What?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Because you know when to continue, and when to stop first.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki is still nervous and still blushes, but this time she does not immediately avoid his gaze.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Dr. Sakaguchi. In the future… if I truly work in surgery…”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I think I can work normally beside you.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Did you not already do that today?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki stares for several seconds, then lowers her head with a smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…I suppose I did.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: After Satsuki leaves, Hiroko steps out through the operating-room door.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Her first formal rotation, and she encounters a patient like that.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Good luck.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Hiroko looks at him.
